RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is not evidence of anything on its own. Teaching and school administration are female-majority fields, so such panels arise by chance constantly; the same logic would clear every all-male panel that ever picked a man. Raising it signals grievance rather than grounds, and weakens the complaint you actually have.

Your real issue is substantive: on the published criteria your leadership qualifications look stronger, and the unanswered request for written reasons may breach administrative or procedural obligations where you are. Chase that in writing, citing any statutory deadline, and ask for the scoring and criteria.

If the reasons, once given, don't rationally support the choice, you have something. The panel's composition still won't be it.
